decisions.reason: Because this formwork profile system is close to the firm's core formwork and factory-equipment knowledge, backed by in-house R&D, and already had its own web page, management would likely keep it and refine it rather than withdraw it quickly.

This automated concrete distributor flow control builds directly on the firm's automation capabilities, which fits its knowledge base and growth direction, so early uncertainty would more likely lead to improvement than exit.

The shuttering magnet block is still close enough to existing formwork know-how to be absorbable, but its weaker web presence suggests slightly less commitment or traction, raising the chance of withdrawal somewhat.

Magnetic formwork strips are close to the established offer and were presented on a dedicated page, so a medium-sized German machinery firm with its own R&D would usually keep them on the market and learn from initial feedback.
This magnetic formwork component fits the firm's established modular formwork business and received dedicated promotion, making continued commercialization more likely than discontinuation.

Although this magnetic formwork component is related to the firm's existing knowledge, its limited website visibility and apparent overlap with other magnetic formwork items make it the most plausible candidate for later rationalization, but not yet the likeliest outcome within a year.
